newsitem.title: INDIA: Rabri Devi wins confidence vote in India state.
newsitem.headline: Rabri Devi wins confidence vote in India state.

text.p: Chief Minister Rabri Devi's Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) party government won a vote of confidence in the Bihar state assembly on Monday, state officials said.

They said Devi, who was sworn in on Friday following the resignation of her husband, Laloo Prasad Yadav, got 194 votes in favour of the confidence motion, while 110 lawmakers voted against in the 324-member assembly.

Devi's government received support from the Congress party, which had abstained during a vote of confidence that Yadav won on July 15, and also from regional parties demanding a separate Jharkhand province carved out of Bihar.

Yadav resigned under political and legal pressure after a court issued a warrant on Friday for his arrest in a corruption case forming part of a $280-million scandal involving alleged diversion of animal welfare funds.

The Supreme Court has stayed Yadav's arrest until Tuesday, when it will hear his appeal in the case in which the federal police indicted him. Yadav says he is innocent, and had refused to resign and face trial until Friday.
His intrasigence created sharp divides in Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's centre-left United Front coalition.
